reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for deterministic, near-lossless conversation compaction with session-log recall and search features; the README states it performs local text processing without model calls or network access.

summaries.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 的确定性上下文压缩插件，可在保留原始内容指针的同时提供会话日志召回、搜索和人工 /recall 命令。
summaries.en: A deterministic DeepSeek Harness context-compaction plugin that preserves pointers to original content while providing session-log recall, search, and a human-facing /recall command.

capabilities: Reading the durable session log for recall and keyword or regex search
Providing model-facing recall and search tools
Providing a human-facing /recall command that appends matching log content to the session
Optionally writing compilation diagnostics to a local debug log
